description: This file defines an interface that specifies configuration options related to AWS S3's ARN region usage within the AWS SDK for PHP.

classes.name: ConfigurationInterface
classes.description: An interface that declares methods for checking ARN region usage and retrieving configuration as an array.

methods.name: isUseArnRegion
methods.description: Returns whether or not to use the ARN region if it differs from the client configuration.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array.
